capabilities: Score notes by link degree plus staleness with a configurable half-life
Surface the highest-scoring notes one at a time or in batches from the command palette
Visualize stale orphan notes as a piled sand mountain in the right sidebar
Append each judged note to a tidying log file and show a history chart
Exclude hub-tagged notes and configured folders from candidates
disambiguation: Not an automated linter or cleaner; it only surfaces candidate notes and leaves the split-or-keep judgment to you.
extras: Works entirely offline and never modifies existing notes; only writes its settings and one appended line per judgment to a log file. Pre-release builds available via BRAT. Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or newer. Japanese README available.
motivation: The author wants a periodic ritual to confront notes a past self let sprawl, and to decide whether to split or keep them.
problem: Notes that quietly accumulated too many links, or orphans left untouched for months, are hard to spot in the graph view or file list.
summary: Vault-tidying tool that ranks over-connected, stale notes by link degree and freshness, and surfaces orphans as a clutter mountain for manual review.
